E1.text: Elizabeth Chase Olsen (born February 16, 1989) is an American actress.

E2.text: Known for her roles in blockbusters and independent dramas, her accolades include nominations for a BAFTA Award, an Emmy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.

E25.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E25.text: Born in Los Angeles, Olsen began acting at age four alongside her sisters Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

E26.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E26.text: She had her film debut in the thriller Martha Marcy May Marlene (2011), for which she garnered praise.

E27.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E27.text: She then took on roles in the horror film Silent House (2012) and the action film Godzilla (2014), received a nomination for the BAFTA Rising Star Award, and graduated from New York University.

E28.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E28.text: She gained worldwide recognition for portraying Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) since 2014, with the miniseries WandaVision (2021) earning her nominations for the Golden Globe and Primetime Emmy for Best Actress.

E33.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E33.text: Olsen began acting when she was four years old, appearing in Mary-Kate and Ashley's projects, including the 1994 television film How the West Was Fun and the straight-to-video series The Adventures of Mary-Kate & Ashley.

E34.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E34.text: After her sisters' music success with their sophomore album I Am The Cute One, Olsen was signed by their label BMG Kidz in August 1994.

E35.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E35.text: Despite being signed to the children's music label, Olsen never recorded any music.

E36.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E36.text: As a child, she took ballet lessons and acting classes and spent time at musical theatre camp.

E37.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E37.text: For a time, she chose ballet over acting and at one point wanted to work as an accountant at Wall Street.

E38.text: Olsen has credited Diane Keaton as a primary influence, both in her acting and personal life.

section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E42.text: Olsen starred in the 2015 superhero film Avengers: Age of Ultron, a sequel to The Avengers, joining the Marvel Cinematic Universe media franchise.

E43.title: Elizabeth Olsen
section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E43.text: In the film, she portrayed Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch, which marked the comic book character's film debut.

E44.title: Elizabeth Olsen
section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E44.text: She first appeared as the character in a post-credits scene of the 2014 film Captain America: The Winter Soldier, alongside Aaron Taylor-Johnson, who portrayed Maximoff's brother, Pietro.

E45.title: Elizabeth Olsen
section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E45.text: Olsen played the part with an accent originating from a fictional country called Sokovia, which she described as similar to Slovak.

E46.title: Elizabeth Olsen
section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E46.text: She reprised the role in Captain America: Civil War (2016), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), and Avengers: Endgame (2019), the last of which became the second highest-grossing film of all time.

E47.title: Elizabeth Olsen
section_path: Introduction into the Marvel Cinematic Universe (2015–2019)
E47.text: With the role, Olsen rose to fame.

E48.title: Elizabeth Olsen
E48.text: Her older sisters, Mary-Kate and Ashley, have also influenced her and given her career advice, though at one point Olsen considered changing her name to her middle name, Chase, to distance herself from her sisters, as she wanted to be noticed for her talent and not solely for being their sister.
